gaps: CH4, NOx and SO2 are deliberately zero in this table because they are booked on the crude-oil/natural-gas extraction dataset; if the BAFU dataset re-adds them they cannot be read from this excerpt.
No water or land flows are given.
All heavy-metal emissions are extrapolated from automobile literature, so their absolute level is weak (StDv95 ~5).
